name: Natalie vs. The Mind
summary:
A visual novel about a girl entering a new life chapter with a challenge nobody has faced before; a demon named Collapsa inhabits our heroine’s body. Collapsa meddles in her personal life and makes it a living hell. The player has to help Natalie to navigate her senior year of high school while trying to survive possession.

Content Warning:

suicide
murder
a demon who loves to ruin your life
